lines.lyric_hangul: 어제 몇 번이고 연습했는데
lines.lyric_translation: I practiced so much yesterday

lines.lyric: Jigeum nae pyojeong bwa maldo motage
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 내 표정 봐 말도 못하게
lines.lyric_translation: But look at me now, I can’t even talk

lines.lyric_hangul: 두근두근 대 나 들키면 어쩌나
lines.lyric_translation: My heart keeps pounding, what if you hear?

lines.lyric_hangul: 태연한 척 눈치채지 못하게
lines.lyric_translation: I try to act calm so you won’t notice

lines.lyric_hangul: 혹시 네가 알면 좀 난 몰라
lines.lyric_translation: Maybe it’d be better if you knew

lines.lyric_hangul: 네 발걸음 맞춰도 너 몰래
lines.lyric_translation: I try matching my footsteps with yours

lines.lyric_hangul: 어쩜 그리 걷는 것도 고와
lines.lyric_translation: How can even the way you walk be so pretty?

lines.lyric: Andwae Pang pang shimjang teojil kkeot gata
lines.lyric_hangul: 안돼 pang pang 심장 터질 것 같아
lines.lyric_translation: No, pang pang, my heart is about to explode

lines.lyric_hangul: Maybe you 나를 생각하고 있을까
lines.lyric_translation: Maybe you / Are you thinking about me?

lines.lyric: Neomuneomu joa altteut maltteut Oh boy
lines.lyric_hangul: 너무너무 좋아 알듯 말듯 oh boy
lines.lyric_translation: I like you show much, so I can know, oh boy

lines.lyric_hangul: 이젠 좀 보여줘 네 맘
lines.lyric_translation: Show me your heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 손 꼭 붙잡아줄래
lines.lyric_translation: Will you hold my hand?

lines.lyric_hangul: 천천히 next page
lines.lyric_translation: Slowly to the next page

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 만드는 레시피에
lines.lyric_translation: The recipe to make me

lines.lyric_hangul: 다음 멘트 나와있잖아
lines.lyric_translation: The next step is here

lines.lyric: Weollae nan hangsang da ppalgan buriya
lines.lyric_hangul: 원래 난 항상 다 빨간 불이야
lines.lyric_translation: My cheeks are always red

lines.lyric: Geunde oneureun jom dalla chorok buriya
lines.lyric_hangul: 근데 오늘은 좀 달라 초록 불이야
lines.lyric_translation: But today, it’s different

lines.lyric: Noran buldo an deureowa nuga jom mallyeo bwa
lines.lyric_hangul: 노란 불도 안 들어와 누가 좀 말려봐
lines.lyric_translation: My cheeks are green

lines.lyric_hangul: 어쩜 좋아 볼은 분홍 불이네
lines.lyric_translation: It’s not even a yellow light, someone stop me

lines.lyric_hangul: 이건 내가 봐도 좀 심각해

lines.lyric_hangul: 친구들도 날 보고 걱정해

lines.lyric_hangul: 어쩜 그리 내 맘 몰라줄까
